Kernel Primitives.source: packages/ui/src/styles.css raw scales (brand/neutral/status/viz/commodity) + light/base/dark and status/* aliases

Kernel Metrics.source: radius, control heights (decision 0010), motion durations (decision 0018), spacing unit

textStyles.note: 18 local text styles: text/{2xs,xs,sm,base,lg}/{regular,medium}, text/{xl,2xl,3xl}/{regular,semibold}, mono/{sm,xs}. Sans stand-in: Inter (code uses system-ui stack); mono stand-in: Roboto Mono. Sizes = Tailwind scale + custom text-2xs (11/16) from styles.css.

Tokens.note: Reference swatch sheets; every swatch fill / metric bar is bound to a variable.

component.button.note: Mirrors @kernel/ui buttonVariants (icon sizes omitted). Heights bound to control-h vars, colors bound to semantic vars, destructive bg at 10% opacity like code. Radius bound to radius/lg (radius/md for xs/sm), paddings/gaps bound to spacing vars per size, sm label 12.8px (text-[0.8rem]).

object.workspace.note: App shell exploration — icon rail + top bar + left/canvas/right panels. Not yet componentized or token-bound.
